dialogues.en:
<$comeff(4,5)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,661)><$voicel(4,6)>Hey! Hey, <$cdef(27)>! Um, you know how
you’re
always
making
homes
for us?

<$comeff(4,10)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,8)>Well, I know a home you could make! I’ll tell you all
about it!

<$comeff(4,3)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,805)><$voicel(4,5)>It’s for a Pokémon called <$cdef(27)>Froakie. I saw them in places
like this all the time!

<$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,805)><$voicel(4,3)>Hey, <$cdef(27)>! <$comeff(4,6)>You like making homes
for Pokémon, right?
<$comeff(4,10)><$motion(4,661)><$voicel(4,8)>Then lemme share a li’l secret!

<$comeff(4,14)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,3)>There’s a pond with a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1416)> in it around here, and a
long time ago...
<$comeff(4,3)><$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,8)>I saw a <$cdef(27)>Dragonite living in a spot like that!

<$comeff(4,21)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,801)><$voicel(4,10)><$cdef(27)>Dragonite seems super spacey, but they look SO cool
when they fly!

<$comeff(4,14)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,5)>You made me such a niiice home. I really want to do
something for yooouuu in return...but what can I do...
<$comeff(4,20)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,8)>Ohhh. I have an ideeea...

<$comeff(4,3)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,8)>You’re a <$cdef(27)>Ditto, riiight? So you should be able to
<$cdef(27)><$spwfull(36)> into meee...
<$comeff(4,9)><$facial(4,4)><$voicel(4,9)>Then I can teach you how to fly. Like this...
<$comeff(4,10)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,801)><$voicel(4,10)>Whoooaaa... You look just like meee.

<$comeff(4,3)><$facial(4,2)><$motion(4,805)><$voicel(4,6)>OK... We should praaactice a little to make sure you can
have fun and stay safe. <$comeff(4,9)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,7)>Come over heeere with me...
<$comeff(4,9)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,812)><$voicel(4,8)>Let’s go praaactice...

<$comeff(4,3)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,661)><$voicel(4,5)>You’re still a beginner, so it might be hard for you to
really zip around in the sky...
<$comeff(4,10)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,805)><$voicel(4,8)>Maaaybe fly wasn’t the right word... <$cdef(27)>Glide? Yeahhh,
you’ll be gliding...

<$comeff(4,14)><$facial(4,1)><$voicel(4,5)>Ummm... It’s not flying exactly... More like <$cdef(27)>falling
reeeaaally sloooooowly...
<$comeff(4,9)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,801)><$voicel(4,7)>But that’s OK. You won’t have to worry about getting
hurt, and moving between islands will be really easy...

<$comeff(4,14)><$facial(4,1)><$voicel(4,5)>Ummm... It’s not flying exactly... More like <$cdef(27)>falling
reeeaaally sloooooowly...
<$comeff(4,9)><$facial(4,4)><$voicel(4,7)><$motion(4,801)>But that’s OK. You won’t have to worry about getting
hurt, and moving between islands will be really easy...

<$comeff(4,21)><$facial(4,1)><$voicel(4,9)>Let’s try going to the next islaaand. Just <$cdef(27)>glide and follow
my leeeaaad...
<$comeff(4,13)><$facial(4,4)><$voicel(4,10)>Yayyy. You did really well. Flying is lots of fun, iiisn’t it?

<$comeff(4,3)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,661)><$voicel(4,7)>Now anytime you want to go to another islaaand, you can
just use <$cdef(27)>Glide and it will be suuuper easy...

<$textsize(2)>*BANG!* *CLANG!*
*CRASH!* *SMASH!*
<$comeff(4,6)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,5)>Hmmm? What’s that sooouuund?

<$voicel(4,7)><$motion(4,806)><$comeff(4,3)>I thiiink it’s coming from the top of that building
over there...

<$comeff(4,14)><$facial(4,1)><$voicel(4,3)>I reeeaaally want to know what it is, but I need to head
back pretty soon...
<$comeff(4,6)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,7)>I bet you could climb up to the top of the building and
check it out, thooouuugh...

<$textsize(2)>*BANG!* *CLANG!*
*CRASH!* *SMASH!*
<$voicel(2,4)>Oops... Might’ve messed up...

<$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,7)>Yeesh, what a mess. Didn’t expect that weird machine
thingy to literally blow up in my face!

<$comeff(2,6)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,8)>Huh? Who’re you? Where’d you come from? What’re you
even doin’ here?

<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,3)>Well, I’ll be! You’re fixin’ up the town to bring in more
Pokémon?
<$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,664)><$voicel(2,9)>That sure sounds like a fun undertaking, it does!

<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,10)>Bahahaha! Sorry ya had to see all that mess. Don’t worry
’bout me—I’m built hardy enough that I can handle a big
boom like that.
<$comeff(2,6)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,8)>So...you’re fixin’ up a town to bring in more Pokémon?
<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,664)><$voicel(2,6)>That sure sounds like a fun undertaking, it does!

<$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,8)>I love big, tall buildings, see.
<$comeff(2,13)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,10)>I spend my time collectin’ junk from here and there and
tryin’ to assemble it all into somethin’ interesting.
<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,5)>Like this tower here! I built this whole thing, believe it
or not! It’s why I call myself the <$cdef(27)>Tinkmaster!
<$comeff(4,3)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,811)><$voicel(4,7)>Follow meee...
